title: Public Safety Source Status for August 17, 2026
summary: Most public safety data sources available in the application remained stable in checks completed on **August 17, 2026**. The main exception is Brazil's ANVISA alert platform: after ANVISA introduced a new consultation tool on **July 6, 2026**, automated access still appears unreliable, which may delay or reduce the latest ANVISA alert results shown in the application.
updates: Brazil (ANVISA): ANVISA said on **July 6, 2026** that its new alert consultation tool replaced the older Sistec workflow. The public portal remains available in a web browser, but automated collection is still inconsistent, so recent ANVISA alert coverage may be incomplete for now. [ANVISA notice](https://www.gov.br/anvisa/pt-br/assuntos/noticias-anvisa/2026/anvisa-disponibiliza-nova-ferramenta-para-consulta-de-alertas-sanitarios)
no_major_changes: FDA MAUDE, FDA Recall, FDA CDRH Recalls, FDA Safety Communications, BfArM, Swissmedic, MHRA, TGA DAEN, TGA DRAC, Health Canada DHPR, Canada Recall, AEMPS, ANSM, PMDA, and NMPA English showed no significant public setup or access change in this check.
